A '''guard''' was a jailkeeper in the [[prison]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime]], working for a [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Brutus]].<ref name="Very Interesting" /> Some time around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the guard came up to a [[Unidentified guard (electro-shock prod)|colleague]] of theirs who had only finished electrocuting a [[Unidentified electrocuted prisoner|Talpiddian inmate]]. Unbeknownst to the two guards, another inmate, [[Jod Na Nawood]],<ref name="Very Interesting" /> was on his<ref name="Databank-Captain Silvo">{{Databank|captain-silvo|Captain Silvo}}</ref> way out of the facility. In order to distract the jailkeepers, he used [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|telekinetically]] move a certain object at a fair distance from him. Since the two guards had dashed away to check on the disturbing sound, Jod's fellow fugitive [[KB]] could sneak across the hallway without being noticed.<ref name="Very Interesting" />

==Personality and traits==
The guard was a [[humanoid]] that wore a rugged and heavily armored outfit, including a face-concealing helmet.<ref name="Very Interesting" />
